title: California AG subpoenas Nvidia over worries about Huang's ties with China | TechCrunch
summary: California’s Attorney General Rob Bonta on Thursday evening said the state has served an investigative subpoena to Nvidia following news of former CEO Jensen Huang’s affair with a woman who the U.S. government believes is a Chinese spy.
